claims: Cassandra Kulukundis won the inaugural Best Casting Oscar at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026, for her work on Paul Thomas Anderson's One Battle After Another.
One Battle After Another won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.
One Battle After Another won Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards.
The Best Casting Oscar was the first-ever Academy Award presented for casting.
The Best Casting is a new competitive category added in 2026.
Francine Maisler was nominated for the inaugural Best Casting Oscar for Sinners.
Nina Gold was nominated for the inaugural Best Casting Oscar for Hamnet.
Jennifer Venditti was nominated for the inaugural Best Casting Oscar for Marty Supreme.
Gabriel Domingues was nominated for the inaugural Best Casting Oscar for The Secret Agent.
